refinement_origin_boundary.archive_fact: v12.11 explicitly found score-solder subdivision additivity only under affine/transport-consistent score refinement; generic independent intermediate scores break it
refinement_origin_boundary.consequence: the current ontology does not select the refinement path of local marginals/BKM metrics, so the continuum fate of Qh is not derived

projection_no_go.repair: in q-orthonormal frames A_ij=S_i O_ij S_j^-1; projecting to U_ij=polar(A_ij) enforces metric compatibility and is the nearest-orthogonal repair in that chosen norm
projection_no_go.theorem: metric-compatible projection is not a gauge transformation: it changes gauge-invariant loop holonomy. Metric compatibility alone also leaves orthogonal freedom; nearest-polar repair is selected only after adding a new minimal-distortion criterion.

relation_to_historical_nonmetricity.note: The older retained-recombination connection separately exhibited RG-stable nonmetricity under its own coarse-graining. That is architectural precedent, not evidence that the new BKM-polar nonmetricity has the same continuum fate.
